sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/VibeVoice: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
sources.snippet: VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models that includes both Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models. A core innovation of VibeVoice is its use of continuous speech tokenizers (Acoustic and Semantic) operating at an ultra-low frame rate of 7.5 Hz. sources.snippet: VibeVoice-ASR is a unified speech-to-text model designed to handle 60-minute long-form audio in a single pass, generating structured transcriptions containing Who (Speaker), When (Timestamps), and What (Content), with support for Customized Hotwords and over 50 languages.

sources.title: VibeVoice ASR & Realtime TTS | Open-Source Voice AI
sources.snippet: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI VibeVoice ASR and realtime TTS in one open-source voice AI overview. VibeVoice combines 60-minute single-pass ASR, streaming-friendly realtime TTS, and the research arc of long-form multi-speaker voice generation into one sharp public release narrative. Independent editorial guide to the public VibeVoice release materials, demos, weights, and papers.
